endpoints.summary: Bulk remove aliases from repository assets in group (Early Access)

details.description:
Detach one or more aliased URLs from their canonical repository assets within a group. Each removed URL gets a new standalone asset document.

#### Required permissions

- `Edit Group Details (group.edit)`
details.summary: Bulk remove aliases from repository assets in group (Early Access)

endpoints.summary: List repository aliases in group (Early Access)

details.description:
Returns a paginated list of alias URL entries for repository assets within a group. Use the optional url filter to restrict results to a specific canonical document.

#### Required permissions

- `View Groups (group.read)`

parameters.description: Maximum number of alias items to return per page. A single canonical document with multiple aliases may span more than one page.
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Paginated list of repository alias entries

oneOf.description: A string containing the link’s URL.

meta.description: Free-form object that may contain non-standard information.

AssetTagsUpdate.description: Updates the asset's custom tags by adding or removing tag key-value pairs.

add.description: Tags to add to the asset (key-value pairs). Tag keys must be 1-30 characters long and contain only alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens.

remove.description: Tag keys to remove from the asset

id.description: The _id of the canonical reference document in the asset-reference collection

AssetLabelsUpdate.description: Updates the asset's labels by adding or removing label values.

add.description: Labels to add to the asset

remove.description: Labels to remove from the asset

app_context.description: asset metadata from App Context integrations

archived.description: Indicates if the asset is archived

base_image.description: Base image of the container image

default_branch_name.description: Default branch name of the repository

developers.description: List of developers associated with the asset

image_digests.description: List of digests for the container image

image_registries.description: List of registries containing the container image

image_repositories.description: List of repositories containing the container image

image_tags.description: List of tags for the container image

labels.description: Unstructured, simple text strings that can be applied to an asset

languages.description: Languages used in the asset with usage counts

name.description: Name of the asset of the file path

reason.description:
Reason for removal:
- repo-archived - The asset was archived on the SCM.
- repo-deleted - The asset was deleted on the SCM.
- org-level-inactive - The Org-Level integration/profile is inactive.
- snyk-project-deleted - The associated Snyk Project was deleted and Snyk was the only source.
- deleted-profile - The integration profile was deleted.

repository_freshness.description: Indicating the activity level of the repository

risk_factors.description: Runtime context that indicates increased asset risk

sources.description: List of source identifiers for the asset

tags.description: Explicitly defined, key:value pairs that are associated with an asset

new_url.description: The alias URL on the canonical document

url.description: The primary URL of the canonical document

AssetClass.description:
Sets the asset's class using either a rank (a number between 1 and 4) or a display name (e.g., "A," "B," "C," or "D"). If both rank and name are provided, rank takes precedence.
* This attribute accepts a single value. It can be locked: When a class attribute is "locked", this attribute will not be affected by any policy.
  * UI: When the user changes the asset class, by default is "locked".
  * API: The user will need to indicate wether they want to "lock" the class attribute.

locked.description: Whether the asset class is locked

discovered_by.description: The SCM integration that was discovered by the developer

new_url.description: The aliased URL to detach from its canonical asset

url.description: The primary URL of the canonical document that owns the alias. Used to verify the request targets the correct document.

attribute.description:
Name of the Asset attribute to filter on, not required if a logical operator is used.

**Tags Filtering:**

The API supports filtering on tags using dot notation:

- **Tags**: `tags.{tagName}` - Filter by tag keys (e.g., `tags.environment`, `tags.team`, `tags.owner`)

operator.description: Required, name of the Operator for the query

values.description: Required values, which can be strings, dates, integers, booleans, or nested attributes

oneOf.description: A date value in ISO 8601 format

next.description: Link to the next page (if available)

prev.description: Link to the previous page (if available)

SearchObject.description: The request body can be empty or include query parameters.

id.description: The _id of the canonical reference document in the asset-reference collection

organizations.description: Snyk Organizations with Projects that map to this asset

AssetClassAttributes.description:
Mandated, hierarchical attribute that provides a standardized measure of an asset's importance to the business. It can be a number from 1-4 or a display name (e.g "A", "B", "C" or "D").
The locked status is a boolean flag that, when true, prevents automated policy-driven actions from overriding the manually set Business Criticality (Class) value.

locked.description: Whether the asset class is locked

rank.description: Rank associated with the asset class

new_url.description: The alias URL to link to the canonical URL

gap.description: indicates if there is a coverage gap

last_scan.description: Last scan date for this control
